# Blockscaner

> Blockscaner is a European platform to buy, sell and swap crypto-assets such as Bitcoin and Ethereum, with live EUR market data, an account wallet with currency exchange, and multi-language support (EN, DE, FR, ES, IT).

Blockscaner offers a live crypto markets page with prices, 7-day trends, market capitalisation and volume; a detail page for every listed crypto-asset with live charts and explainer content; and an account area where verified users hold balances, convert between currencies and request withdrawals.

## Pages

- / — Homepage: platform overview and sign-up entry points
- /markets — Live crypto markets: EUR prices, sparklines, market cap and 24h volume for listed assets
- /markets/{coin-id} — Detail page per crypto-asset: live price chart, market data, explainer sections and buying steps (e.g. /markets/bitcoin, /markets/ethereum, /markets/solana)
- /products — Platform products overview
- /business — Services for business clients
- /about — About the platform
- /blog — Academy: guides and insights on crypto-assets
- /support — Help and support

## Access

Public pages are listed above. The account area (/account), admin area and case tracker require sign-in and are not crawlable content.
